name: Empower Gwinnett Government Internship Program
what_you_do: Two Saturday workshops in May, then a four-week paid internship in a county department. The page says interns develop leadership skills through workshops and on-the-job training.
who_can_apply: Gwinnett County residents or students who go to school in Gwinnett County, ages 15 to 21. You must be 15 by the first workshop. You must be free for the whole paid internship program. You need a reliable ride. You cannot be a past Empower Gwinnett County Government intern. If you are 15, you need a work permit. No grades or work experience are required.
pay_detail: $15 per hour for the two workshops and the four-week internship
deadline_text: 2027 applications open Feb 8, 2027 and close Mar 15, 2027. The schedule page shows two sets of later dates: workshops May 8 and May 15 or May 9 and May 16, internship May 31 to June 25 or June 1 to June 26. Confirm them.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application during the posted window. The page has no form link yet. Human Resources picks applicants based on interests, career goals and department needs. No interview is required. Selected applicants get a conditional job offer. Some jobs may need a background check.
notes: The job list on the page is still for 2026. Some jobs have a higher minimum age. Questions: HREmployeeEngagement@GwinnettCounty.com.
